name: Veil of the Glade
summary: The veil falls on an Auros and the die decides the gift.

face.name: Veil of the Glade

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Choose an Auros Entity you control and roll a d6: on 1–2 it gets +1 Power until end of turn and you may untap it; on 3–4 it gets +2 Power until end of turn; on 5–6 it gets +1 Power until end of turn and you gain 1 HP.

face.flavor: The glade does not promise. It offers.
